Lower Text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted, gain 1 memory.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Growlmon] or [Gallantmon] in its name and 1 [X Antibody] among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
